usage: Refers to one of the soft, colorful parts of a flower; in Cantonese, 花瓣 is the natural word for a petal.
Commonly used with flower names or phrases about shapes, colors, and count, especially in simple nature descriptions.
Sounds neutral and everyday, suitable for both speaking and writing; no special slang or formal register.
For learners: 花瓣 is usually the part you can count one by one, so it often appears with numbers or measures in plant descriptions.
